body.name: Projected full-loss germ handle
body.construction: Compile the finite semilinear graph of \(f(u,q)=d_H(S(P_Eu),S(q))\) by pathwise primal--dual elimination; substitute \(u=q\) into every cell boundary and affine value intercept; normalize these diagonal forms; snap forms within \(\kappa_n\) of zero with \(\kappa_n\downarrow0\) and \(\sqrt n\kappa_n\to\infty\); restrict all incident pieces and Gaussian draws to \(T\)
